subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------ TRS.
description: Diagram in CMOA(I)-13 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — Britain/Germany/Holland), first of two on book p219. Accompanies Braxton's structural turn: 'it becomes more a question of musicians celebrating their creativity in accordance with the vibrational dictates of their environment as well as their own cultural and vibrational pull.' MT-INFO (multi-information) is crossed with TRS (transition): the question is what multi-information produces when crossed with transition — under conditions where each European musician is celebrating both environment and personal vibration. A vertical from the main line rises to PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental); from it a horizontal runs left to LANG-DY (language dynamics), which carries C-INFO (composite information) above and TR-INFO (trans-information) on the lower-left. TRS itself is the partner. P-PROG (particular progressionalism) anchors the right output, branching from the main line. CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) hangs on the lower-right from P-PROG. PART (participation) hangs from CULT-SOLD, and PRI-INFO (principle information) from PART at the bottom-center. The lower output cluster (participation, principle-information, culture-solidification, particular-progressionalism) registers the productive structure of European creativity: when multi-information genuinely crosses with transition, the productive output is particular-progressionalism, which carries culture-solidification, participation and principle-information in a single chain.
